purpose: Track external quantum-computing datasets used as problem sources and evaluation benchmarks for the tutor.

use_external_data_as: verified exercise and circuit problem sources
do_not: copy external answers directly into tutor training without review
use held-out benchmark problems in training
treat an LLM-generated answer as mathematical ground truth
policy.verification: Execute circuits and tests with Qiskit/Qiskit Aer before creating VERIFIED_FACTS.
policy.split_policy: Split by source problem, not by generated tutoring response, to prevent train/evaluation leakage.

datasets.name: Qiskit QuantumKatas
datasets.description: 350 quantum-computing tasks across 26 categories, translated from Microsoft's QuantumKatas to Qiskit.
intended_use: provide topic coverage for training examples

requirements: share adaptations under the same license
do not use the dataset or derivatives for commercial purposes without permission

datasets.citation: Qiskit community, Qiskit-QuantumKatas; derived in part from Microsoft QuantumKatas.
datasets.status: approved as a non-commercial source pending expert review of each derived example

datasets.name: Qiskit HumanEval
datasets.description: 151 human-written Qiskit problems with standard and hard prompt variants for execution-based code evaluation.
intended_use: held-out evaluation of Qiskit code generation

requirements: include the Apache-2.0 license and required notices when redistributing covered material

datasets.citation: Qiskit community, Qiskit HumanEval: An Evaluation Benchmark For Quantum Code Generative Models, arXiv:2406.14712.
datasets.status: approved as a benchmark and source of expert-reviewed examples
datasets.split_rule: Keep selected HumanEval problems completely held out from tutor training when used for final comparison.
